title: Homework 2 - Grace Haley
text:
Create vectors for the pre-treatment and post-treatment blood pressure measurements.

pre_bp <- c(
  130, 128, 116, 124, 133,
  134, 118, 126, 114, 127,
  141, 138, 128, 140, 137,
  131, 120, 128, 139, 135
)

post_bp <- c(
  114, 98, 113, 99, 107,
  116, 113, 111, 119, 117,
  101, 119, 130, 122, 106,
  106, 124, 102, 117, 113
)




Assign subject names to each vector.

patient_names <- paste("Subject", 1:20, sep = "_")

names(pre_bp) <- patient_names
names(post_bp) <- patient_names

pre_bp

 Subject_1  Subject_2  Subject_3  Subject_4  Subject_5  Subject_6  Subject_7 
       130        128        116        124        133        134        118 
 Subject_8  Subject_9 Subject_10 Subject_11 Subject_12 Subject_13 Subject_14 
       126        114        127        141        138        128        140 
Subject_15 Subject_16 Subject_17 Subject_18 Subject_19 Subject_20 
       137        131        120        128        139        135 

post_bp

 Subject_1  Subject_2  Subject_3  Subject_4  Subject_5  Subject_6  Subject_7 
       114         98        113         99        107        116        113 
 Subject_8  Subject_9 Subject_10 Subject_11 Subject_12 Subject_13 Subject_14 
       111        119        117        101        119        130        122 
Subject_15 Subject_16 Subject_17 Subject_18 Subject_19 Subject_20 
       106        106        124        102        117        113 





Calculate the change in blood pressure for each patient by subtracting the post-treatment measurements from the pre-treatment measurements.

diff_bp <- pre_bp - post_bp
diff_bp

 Subject_1  Subject_2  Subject_3  Subject_4  Subject_5  Subject_6  Subject_7 
        16         30          3         25         26         18          5 
 Subject_8  Subject_9 Subject_10 Subject_11 Subject_12 Subject_13 Subject_14 
        15         -5         10         40         19         -2         18 
Subject_15 Subject_16 Subject_17 Subject_18 Subject_19 Subject_20 
        31         25         -4         26         22         22 





Calculate the average decrease in blood pressure across all patients.

mean(diff_bp)

[1] 17





Determine which patients experienced a decrease in blood pressure after treatment using the which() function.

which(diff_bp > 0)

 Subject_1  Subject_2  Subject_3  Subject_4  Subject_5  Subject_6  Subject_7 
         1          2          3          4          5          6          7 
 Subject_8 Subject_10 Subject_11 Subject_12 Subject_14 Subject_15 Subject_16 
         8         10         11         12         14         15         16 
Subject_18 Subject_19 Subject_20 
        18         19         20 





Subset the vector of differences to return only those with a positive change.

positive_changes <- diff_bp[diff_bp > 0]

positive_changes

 Subject_1  Subject_2  Subject_3  Subject_4  Subject_5  Subject_6  Subject_7 
        16         30          3         25         26         18          5 
 Subject_8 Subject_10 Subject_11 Subject_12 Subject_14 Subject_15 Subject_16 
        15         10         40         19         18         31         25 
Subject_18 Subject_19 Subject_20 
        26         22         22 





Calculate the average decrease in blood pressure for only those patients whose blood pressure decreased.

mean(positive_changes)

[1] 20.64706
